notes: Reorders the 'unless' clause but preserves the contrary-intention exception and the joint obligation. No operative loss.
Hindi counterpart; विपरीत आशय qualifier and joint obligation fully retained.
Devolution rule for joint lives and for the representative + survivors is preserved in both stages.
Hindi counterpart; joint-life and post-death devolution both retained.
Drops the precondition that the promisor has not undertaken to perform without application, plus the proper-place and usual-hours qualifiers. Duty becomes unconditional and location/time-unspecified.
Hindi counterpart; precondition and both qualifiers removed.
'may' → 'must'. Converts a liberty of the promisor into a binding requirement; also drops 'or sanctions', narrowing the modes the promisee may accept.
Hindi counterpart; 'किया जा सकता है' → 'किया जाना चाहिए'.
Compensation entitlement is dropped. Rescission survives but the damages claim does not.
Hindi counterpart; क्षतिपूर्ति entitlement removed.
'the legal branch alone can be enforced' → 'neither branch can be enforced'. Severability of the lawful limb is reversed; the whole promise is made unenforceable.
Hindi counterpart; 'केवल विधिपूर्ण शाखा' → 'कोई भी शाखा नहीं'.
Drops three limiting elements: absence of other circumstances, the discretion qualifier, and the express irrelevance of the limitation bar.
Hindi counterpart; qualifying elements dropped.
Drops the equal-standing proportional rule and the limitation-bar clarification. For equal-standing debts the simplification supplies no rule.
Hindi counterpart; समान स्थिति rule dropped.
All three triggering events (substitute, rescind, alter) retained; only stylistic change.
Hindi counterpart; all three triggers retained.
Two of the three options lost (extend time; accept substituted satisfaction). Promisee's powers materially reduced.
Hindi counterpart; समय विस्तार and संतोष options dropped.
Restitution obligation entirely dropped. Rescission is granted while the price of it is concealed — the legally decisive half of the section.
Hindi counterpart; लाभ प्रत्यर्पण obligation dropped.
Cross-reference to proposal communication/revocation rules preserved intact.
Hindi counterpart.
Causal link ('caused thereby') preserved. 'neglects or' is elided but the operative excuse survives.
Hindi counterpart; causal link retained.
Drops 'reasonable compensation not exceeding'. Converts a ceiling on damages into an entitlement to the full stipulated sum — the opposite of the section's purpose.
Hindi counterpart; 'उचित क्षतिपूर्ति' ceiling removed.
Definition of guarantee and the oral/written rule both preserved.
Hindi counterpart.
Drops 'or any promise made'. Excludes executory consideration; matters where the benefit is a promise rather than an act.
Hindi counterpart; 'अथवा दिया गया कोई भी वचन' removed.
Removes the contractual opt-out. Parties lose the ability, expressly preserved by the section, to agree a different liability.
Hindi counterpart; 'जब तक कि संविदा द्वारा अन्यथा उपबंधित न हो' removed.
Pure definitional sentence; no legal content at risk from rewording.
Hindi counterpart.
Drops the guarantee-provision qualifier and the 'or to enforce any other remedy' limb.
Hindi counterpart; qualifier and second limb removed.
Drops two of the three cumulative requirements (creditor's omission of a duty; impairment of the surety's eventual remedy).
Hindi counterpart; two cumulative conditions dropped.
Narrows 'made by, or with his knowledge and assent' to the creditor's own act only, and drops the materiality requirement.
Hindi counterpart; जानकारी/सहमति and सारभूत भाग requirements dropped.
'invalid' → 'voidable at the option of the creditor'. Both the consequence and the party holding the election are invented; the creditor (the party at fault) is given the option.
Hindi counterpart; अविधिमान्य → शून्यकरणीय with the wrong party holding the option.
Drops every qualifying condition, including the 'absence of any contract to the contrary' that lets co-sureties agree a different split.
Hindi counterpart; all qualifications including विपरीत संविदा dropped.
Second simplification of s.10; free consent, competence, lawful consideration/object and the 'not declared void' limb all retained.
Hindi counterpart of the second s.10 simplification.
'must' → 'should'. Modal weakened while the exception limb is retained; isolates the deontic change.
Hindi counterpart; 'करना होगा' → 'करना चाहिए'.
